text.en: Clients describe the staff and facility owner as exceptionally warm, welcoming, and dedicated to each pet's well-being. Pet parents note that team members manage high-energy and rescue dogs with great patience and understanding. Reviewers emphasize that the consistent, family-like care provides them with complete peace of mind while travelling.

Owners emphasize how eager their dogs are to arrive at the resort, often treating daycare like an exciting visit to school. Dogs return home well-fed, calm, and pleasantly tired after socialising safely with other four-legged friends. Long-term clients highlight that sensitive or previously neglected rescue dogs thrive under the attentive daily care.

Pet owners appreciate receiving periodic video clips and photo messages showcasing their dogs playing happily during boarding stays. Clients mention that being able to phone the resort and receive prompt, detailed status reports helps relieve separation anxiety. Families report that the thoughtful communication makes extended travel far less stressful.

q.en: Do owners receive video updates during boarding stays?

a.en: Yes, staff regularly send short video clips and photos showing pets playing and relaxing during their stay.

q.en: Does Danmar Pet Resort offer dog daycare as well as boarding?

a.en: Yes, the facility provides both daily dog daycare and short-term or extended overnight boarding.

q.en: Can high-energy or rescue dogs be accommodated safely?

a.en: Yes, reviewers with energetic rescues note that staff provide structured play and personalized care.

q.en: Are exit baths provided before checkout?

a.en: Yes, clients note that bathing and grooming services can be arranged so dogs return home clean.
